``` r
hj_params <- expand_grid(

  # consider each distinct candidate text width (nested table)
  layouts = layout_candidates |>
    arrange(error, desc(text_pct)) |>
    slice_min(error, by = text_width, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    list(),

  # consider a range of sensible wordspace settings (nested table)
  ws = expand_grid(
    ws_avg = seq(11 / 4, 11 / 3, length.out = 3),
    ws_min = seq(11 / 6, 11 / 5, length.out = 3),
    ws_max = seq(11 / 3, 11 / 2, length.out = 5)
  ) |>
    filter(ws_min < ws_avg, ws_avg < ws_max) |>
    transmute(
      ws = ws_avg / 2.94556,
      ws_stretch = (ws_max - ws_avg) / 1.47278,
      ws_shrink = (ws_avg - ws_min) / 0.98186
    ) |>
    list(),

  # consider a range of harmonious paragraph indentation lengths
  parindent = c(12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20),

  # fine-tune LaTeX hyphenation & justification parameters
  pretolerance = 100, # lower to 0 to skip; increase to 200 to make sloppy
  tolerance = 200, # increase to 500 or 1000 to make sloppy
  hfuzz = 0, # increase to 1 to make sloppy
  emergencystretch = 0, # increase to 0.5 or 1 to make sloppy
  doublehyphendemerits = 1e5, # 1e4 is too sloppy; increase to 1e6 if needed
  hyphenate_responded = FALSE, # avoid if possible

  # don't penalize bad page breaks while evaluating H&J
  interlinepenalty = 0, clubpenalty = 0, widowpenalty = 0, brokenpenalty = 0
) |>
  filter(pretolerance < tolerance) |>
  unnest(layouts) |>
  unnest(ws) |>
  distinct()
```
